name: Open a new share for a member
description: Establish a new share of a given type with an initial deposit, through the review screen. Creating the share is irreversible and is gated accordingly.
goal: Sign on, open member {member_id}, open a new share of type {share_type} with an initial deposit of {initial_deposit}, review it, and establish it.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Operator ID to sign on with (e.g. teller1, super1).

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Operator password. Supplied at invocation and never persisted.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch code to sign on against.

inputs.name: share_type
inputs.description: Share product code, as it appears in the Share Type list: S0001 (Regular Shares), S0070 (Share Draft), MMKT (Money Market) or CERT (Certificate).

outputs.name: confirmation
outputs.description: Confirmation number for the newly established share.
